locations.label: Warden’s Key candidate approaches
locations.description: Look for the hanging Warden’s Key above either the Cafeteria/Showers approach or the Warden’s Office approach. Enter Afterlife, jump through the nearby blue doorway and shock the generator controlling its hook. Revive, then collect the lowered key. One pickup supplies the team’s key doors. While near Warden’s Office, use the ghost passage and shock its door meter to open it. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Upper Cell Block Electric Cherry
locations.description: Shock the small meter by each perk to activate it: Jugger-Nog at Docks, Electric Cherry by the upper Cell Block workbench, Speed Cola in Warden’s Office, Double Tap on the Citadel route and Deadshot in Infirmary. Power the gondola for travel between Cell Block and Docks. There is no Quick Revive machine; Afterlife is your recovery system. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Docks Jugger-Nog
locations.description: Shock the small meter by each perk to activate it: Jugger-Nog at Docks, Electric Cherry by the upper Cell Block workbench, Speed Cola in Warden’s Office, Double Tap on the Citadel route and Deadshot in Infirmary. Power the gondola for travel between Cell Block and Docks. There is no Quick Revive machine; Afterlife is your recovery system. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Plane assembly
locations.description: Use Afterlife in Infirmary, pass through the blue opening and jump up to the roof. Shock the roof-door meter so humans can reach the plane frame. Each player carries one plane part at a time in co-op; solo can collect the complete set. Add parts at the frame when convenient. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Bridge Pack-a-Punch
locations.description: Pack-a-Punch is on the bridge and costs 5,000. Survive the zombies and Brutus while upgrading. The electric chairs appear for the return trip; use them, then revive your bodies back in the prison. On later trips collect fuel cans from the five original part locations and refuel the plane. Wait for the next round if replacement fuel has not appeared. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.
